title: Monday 230703
wodRaw:
Complete as many rounds as possible in 20 minutes of:  
[Row](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/rowing) 300 meters  
3 [rope climbs](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-rope-climb-wrapping), 15 ft 


Post rounds completed to comments.  
Compare to [160522](https://www.crossfit.com/workout/2016/05/22). 
___
**Scaling:**  
If you do not yet have confident rope climbs, spend time practicing the wrapping technique and reduce the reps in each round of the workout. 

**Intermediate Option:**  
Complete as many rounds as possible in 20 minutes of:  
Row 300 meters  
**2** rope climbs, 15 ft

**Beginner Option:**  
Complete as many rounds as possible in 20 minutes of:  
Row 300 meters  
3 rope climbs, **lying to standing**

title: Tuesday 230704
wodRaw:
[Loredo](https://www.crossfit.com/workout/2012/12/31#/comments)  

6 rounds for time of:  
24 [squats](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-air-squat)  
24 [push-ups](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-push-up)  
24 [walking lunge steps](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-walking-lunge)  
Run 400 meters

Post time to comments.  
Compare to [200624](https://www.crossfit.com/200624).

___
**Scaling:**  
Choose a push-up option that will allow you to start each round with 1 large set and then move to smaller sets. Avoid hitting failure. 

**Intermediate Option:**  
**5 rounds** for time of:  
24 squats  
24 push-ups  
24 walking lunge steps  
Run 400 meters

**Beginner Option:**  
**3 rounds** for time of:  
24 squats  
24 **assisted** push-ups   
24 walking lunge steps  
Run 400 meters

title: Wednesday 230705
wodRaw:
Complete as many rounds as possible in 10 minutes of:  

30-second [L-sit](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-l-sit) from the floor  
10 [odd-object cleans](https://www.crossfit.com/at-home/at-home-odd-object-clean)     

Use a 20- to 30-lb. sandbag, ball, backpack, or other odd object for the cleans.

Post rounds completed to comments.  
Compare to [211127](https://www.crossfit.com/211127).  
___
**Scaling:**  
Watch “[L-Sit Drills](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/l-sit-drills),” and modify the L-sit hold to a position you are able to maintain for a full 30 seconds when fresh.  

**Intermediate Option:**  
Complete as many rounds as possible in 10 minutes of:  
30-second **tuck sit**  
10 odd-object cleans  

Use a 20- to 30-lb. sandbag, ball, backpack, or other odd object for the cleans.
 
**Beginner Option:**  
Complete as many rounds as possible in 10 minutes of:  
30-second **seated leg raises**   
10 odd-object cleans 

Use a **10- to 15-lb.** sandbag, ball, backpack, or other odd object for the cleans.

title: Saturday 230708
wodRaw:
[Back squat](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-back-squat) 5-3-3-3-1-1-1-1-1 reps  

For time:   
100 weighted [sit-ups](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-abmat-sit-up)

**♀ 25-lb DB ♂ 35-lb DB**

For time:   
**70 sit-ups**

title: Sunday 230709
wodRaw:
**Kelly**  
5 rounds for time of:

Run 400 meters

title: Tuesday 230711
wodRaw:
Pause [overhead squat](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-overhead-squat) 3-3-3-3-3 reps  
[Squat snatch](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-snatch) 1-1-1-1-1 reps

Post loads to comments.
___
**Scaling:**  
All athletes can work to the best of their ability in the overhead squat sets. Give yourself a 3-second pause for all reps with relatively light weight across all sets. Experienced athletes should build to a heavy snatch single. If you are new to weightlifting, you may choose to perform one power snatch plus one overhead squat. 

**Beginner Option:**  
Pause [overhead squat](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-overhead-squat) 3-3-3-3-3 reps  
[Power snatch](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-power-snatch) + [overhead squat](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-overhead-squat) 1-1-1-1-1 reps

title: Wednesday 230712
wodRaw:
[CrossFit Games Run Swim Run](https://games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2017#events-details)

For time:  
Run 1.5 miles  
Swim 500 meters  
Run 1.5 miles  

Post time to comments.  
Compare to [170803](https://www.crossfit.com/workout/2017/08/03).

___
**Scaling:**  
Choose a running distance that can be completed in approximately 12 minutes. Less- experienced swimmers should consider planning a brief rest interval during the swim. More- experienced athletes should strive to sustain a steady pace throughout the workout. If you do not have access to a pool, ocean, or lake, sub for a bike of similar duration, about 3 miles. 

**Intermediate Option:**  
For time:  
Run 1.5 miles  
Swim **300 meters**   
Run 1.5 miles

**Beginner Option:**   
For time:  
Run 1 miles  
Swim **10 minutes**  
Run 1 miles

title: Thursday 230720

title: Tuesday 230725
wodRaw:
For time:   

Run 1,600 meters  
Rest 3 minutes  
Run 1,200 meters  
Rest 2 minutes  
Run 800 meters  
Rest 1 minute  
Run 400 meters 

Post times to comments.  
Compare to [221009](https://www.crossfit.com/221009).
_________________
**Scaling:**  
Today we have four run efforts, each for time. Experienced athletes should consider their mile PR time and shoot to pace that first mile run at about 90% effort. Increase your pace slightly as the distances get shorter. Deconditioned athletes should reduce the overall volume.

**Beginner Option:**  
For time:    
**Jog 1,200** meters  
Rest **3** minutes  
**Jog 800** meters  
Rest **2** minute  
**Jog 400** meters

title: Thursday 230727
wodRaw:
For time:  
100 [chest-to-bar pull-ups](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-kipping-chest-to-bar-pull-up)     
100 [push-ups](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-push-up)  
100 [GHD sit-ups](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-ghd-sit-up)  
100 [single-leg squats](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-single-leg-squat), alternating

___
**Scaling:**   
This workout demands we keep moving by smartly managing a large number of reps per set. Aim to complete this workout within 20 minutes. Use your warm-up to experiment with pull-ups, push-ups, GHD sit-ups, and single-leg squats. Choose a variation that allows each movement to be completed at a sustainable pace without reaching failure. 

**Intermediate Option:**

**Beginner Option:**
